name: FAAC Allocation
description: Questions about federal allocation disbursements and accountability

questions.question: How much did Bayelsa State receive from FAAC in 2024? Break down the allocation by components — statutory, VAT, derivation.
Compare FAAC allocations between South-South and North-East zones in 2024. Which zone received more and why?
How much did Lagos State receive from FAAC in the last 6 months of 2024? What could that money fund in terms of infrastructure?
What is the total FAAC allocation to Kano State LGAs in 2024? How much does each LGA receive on average?
How much did Akwa Ibom State receive from the 13% derivation fund in 2024? What percentage of their total FAAC allocation does derivation represent?
Compare monthly FAAC allocations to Borno State across 2024. Which months had the highest and lowest allocations?
How much total FAAC allocation did all 36 states and FCT receive in 2024? Which state got the most and which got the least?
